up2parts is an AI-powered, company-specific self-learning software solution that enhances quotation calculation, process planning, production data management, and CAM programming for machine shops. The solution uses 3D model geometry, PMI data, as well as the company’s own machines, tools, materials, cost structures, and manufacturing strategies.

Camcut supplies up2parts solutions and is responsible for their implementation, training, and technical support. The goal is to reduce repetitive manual work, speed up decision-making, and make the company’s own production expertise more effectively available throughout the organization.
More efficient machine shop production powered by AI

Fast quoting, reliable cost calculation, and consistent CAM programming are key factors in competitive machining operations. Yet in many companies, process planning, estimating, and programming still rely on manual spreadsheets, scattered information, and the experience of individual key employees.

This slows down the quoting process, makes it harder to scale operations, and leaves production vulnerable to personnel changes. At the same time, the shortage of skilled workers and increasing cost pressures are creating a greater need to leverage existing production data more effectively.

up2parts combines part geometry, product manufacturing information, and the company’s own production data into a unified digital solution. It enables cost estimates, process plans, and CAM programming recommendations to be generated quickly based on the company’s actual production capabilities.

Automation does not replace expert decision-making. It reduces routine work, provides well-founded recommendations, and frees skilled professionals to focus on more demanding process planning, production development, and solving exceptional manufacturing situations.
A production digital assistant that learns to fit your company

up2parts was developed to meet the practical needs of manufacturing companies. The solution is based on experience in in-house machine shop production, as well as the day-to-day challenges of quotation calculation, process planning, and CAM programming.

The system combines geometric analysis of 3D models with PMI data, or product manufacturing information, and the company’s own production environment. This includes, for example, machine tools, cutting tools, materials, machine-hour rates, process steps, and the machining strategies used.

Based on this information, up2parts generates recommendations tailored to the company’s own operating methods. The solution is not based on traditional macros or rigid rules, but on a company-specific learning system that uses solutions approved by users, corrections made, and accumulated production data.

This creates the company’s own digital production assistant, which supports decision-making and helps standardize proven working methods. At the same time, valuable shop-floor knowledge is captured more effectively and made available for use in future projects.
Geometric similarity search leverages previous production data.

Geometric similarity search is one of up2parts’ key features. The system analyzes the geometry of a new 3D model and searches the company’s database for previously manufactured or quoted parts with similar geometry.

The search is not based solely on the file name, part number, or the user’s memory. It recognizes the geometric characteristics of parts and helps locate previous cases even when they have not been named or stored consistently.

For the parts found, users can review previous process plans, cost calculations, CAM programs, machining methods, and tool selections, for example. This makes it possible to use completed work as the basis for a new quotation or manufacturing plan.

Geometric similarity search reduces the time spent looking for information and helps standardize cost calculations and manufacturing methods. The database grows with every new part, gradually becoming a knowledge base built around the company’s own production practices.
up2parts cockpit brings all production data together in one place

up2parts cockpit serves as the centralized production database for the entire system. It allows 3D models, PDF drawings, process plans, calculations, CAM programs, tool data, and other part-related documents to be stored together in one place.

The centralized knowledge base reduces the need to search for information on network drives, in emails, file folders, and individual employees’ personal archives. The required information is available in connection with the part and can be accessed for quotation calculation, process planning, programming, and production.

Cockpit includes 3D viewing, geometric similarity search, and manufacturability analysis to help identify, for example, geometric features that are critical from a manufacturing perspective. PMI data, such as tolerances, threads, fits, and surface characteristics, can also be linked to the system.

Browser-based access makes it possible to view production data on different workstations and, when needed, directly in the production environment. This makes up-to-date information available to machines and users without the need for extensive local software installations.
